text:
Sam (Growth): Heads-up — prepping the newsletter for next Wednesday. want to lock subject + APAC send window. quick sync?
Marta Chen: 👍 I have two subject sets. leaning toward the one focused on performance benchmarks.
Olivia Park: @Sam any change to the CTA? last minute product link swap?
Sam (Growth): small tweak — swap /getting-started -> /use-cases. keeps trial signups higher per last test.
Eli (Deliverability): pls run the suppressed-domains check again, there were ~120 new bounces yesterday. I can rerun list-cleaner if you want.
Sam (Growth): yes please, Eli. can we also canary 500 seats first to check deliverability for regional domains?
Nora (Ops): canary OK. schedule: canary send Tue 10:00 PDT (500 users), full send Wed 16:00 UTC.
Marta Chen: Subjects (A/B):
```
A) See real latency wins — Redwood Inference benchmark inside
B) How we cut token cost by 3x (short read)
C) Quick: better inference without sacrificing quality
```
Marta Chen: short preview lines: "benchmarks + tips for engineers" vs "save on inference cost today" — which pairs better with B?
Olivia Park: B + "save on inference cost today" feels tight for engineering leads. :rocket:
Eli (Deliverability): also recommend these headers before send:
```
X-Redwood-Test: canary-1
List-Unsubscribe: <https://redwood.example.com/unsub>
```
Eli (Deliverability): and turn on link-wrapping TTL for APAC hosts to reduce click failures.
Sam (Growth): noted. Marta, can you add the final subject + preview to the doc and bump the creative? link: https://docs.redwood.com/sr/marketing/newsletter-2024-06 (draft)
Marta Chen: done. I also trimmed the hero copy to 40 chars for mobile.
Nora (Ops): deploy-bot scheduled the canary:
"canary-send: id=canary-1817654322 users=500 time=2024-06-04T17:00:00Z"
deploy-bot: scheduled send created (canary-1817654322) ✅
Sam (Growth): sweet. After canary, we'll check: open rate, click rate, bounce spikes, and spam-folder flags. if all green -> full send Wed.
Olivia Park: i'll run the heatmap on the template after canary. ping me when canary finishes.
Eli (Deliverability): I'll post a short final report in this thread within 45m of canary completion.
Marta Chen: tiny ask — for APAC cohorts push to local morning where possible. canary is global but full send we should split windows.
Sam (Growth): agreed. split: APAC local morning, EMEA early afternoon, NA morning PT. Ops, can you set send windows?
Nora (Ops): yes. I'll configure send windows and the retry policy for throttles.
Sam (Growth): thanks team ❤️ any last blockers?
Olivia Park: none from design.
Eli (Deliverability): none pending on my side once list-cleaner finishes.
Marta Chen: no blockers.
Sam (Growth): okay locking — final review Mon EOD.
